title: Curcumin Bioavailability in Glioblastoma Patients
brief_summary: Measuring the bioavailability of orally administered curcumin in the tumors of glioblastoma patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients harboring Glioblastoma
* Patient will undergo surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* BMI \> 30
* Liver and Kidney Function so compromised that medication is prescribed
condition: Patient Harboring Glioblastoma That Will Undergo Surgery
